name: OLED Black
description: True black for OLED screens, with cyan and violet accents. Dark only.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: anchor-v1 from the reviewed prototype's oled-black anchors.

fallbacks: Every display mode renders the dark set, high contrast renders the sets high-contrast-v1 derives from it, and print renders the light high-contrast set, since print is always light.
caveats: Dark only: it keeps its native dark mode, so light isn't offered with it.
